summary: NM-ORD007 was dispatched before dispatch set the order-level allocation status, so the order still says RESERVED while its only line is SHIPPED and the order is COMPLETED.

verified_read_only.other_app_orders: HCME-ORD-000001..3 and NM-ORD004..006 are consistent (RESERVED with RESERVED lines, or RELEASED with RELEASED lines); NM-ORD007 is the only stale record.
verified_read_only.stock_effect: None. Stock was already consumed at dispatch (on_hand and reserved reduced by the line quantity). RELEASE only touches lines still RESERVED, so the stale order status cannot release stock twice.

cause_fixed_in_code: app/graph/repositories/fulfilment.py: dispatch now runs MARK_ALLOCATION with status CONSUMED after CONSUME (tests/test_direct_order.py checks RESERVED -> CONSUMED -> CONSUMED).
to_apply_with_authorization: MATCH (o:Order {order_id: 'NM-ORD007', source_id: 'APP-SESSION'}) WHERE o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.allocation_status = 'RESERVED' AND NOT EXISTS { (o)-[:CONTAINS_LINE]->(l:OrderLine) WHERE l.allocation_status <> 'SHIPPED' } SET o.allocation_status = 'CONSUMED', o.allocation_updated_at = '2026-10-28T00:00:00Z' RETURN o.order_id, o.allocation_status
expected_result: One row: NM-ORD007, CONSUMED. Zero rows means the record changed since verification; do not force it.
